datasets.description: Madagascar Medium Term Projection FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic data for 2020. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/madagascar_medium_term_projection__fewsnet_ipc_shapefile_for_2020]
datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular monthly surveys across Madagascar to classify food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework. Geographic boundaries were delineated and assigned IPC phase classifications (1-5) based on field assessments, creating monthly snapshots of acute food insecurity distribution for 2020 medium-term projections.
